set.body: Ordered execution plan following the completed elegance-hardening epic (bd-01KX2DBPK8R7K8PGH3PVZAMPCQ). Sequence: (1) commit the hardening work as a logical series isolated from unrelated working-tree changes; (2) visual gallery smoke check — a human looks at rendered output before more is built on top; (3) semantic expansion from the target-10 epic in dependency order, theme and typed stats first (existing issues, shared with epic bd-01KX2HRDJB08TM7GVCFR8E2PKD); (4) a second real backend (Canvas) proving the conformance contract with an independent implementer; (5) DSL capstone then a re-grade gate that decides whether the system is 10/10. Deps encode the intended order via the ready queue.
set.title: Epic: graphics roadmap — commit, verify visually, expand, prove portability, re-grade
